name: action-sheet
title: Action Sheet
description: An iOS-quality action sheet: grouped rounded cards with hairline separators, an optional title and message, and a separate Cancel card. It springs up over a fading scrim and follows your finger anywhere on the sheet — fling or pull past a third to dismiss, pulling up rubber-bands. Rows highlight on touch with a selection haptic; icons, destructive and disabled options; plus a Material list and a share-sheet grid.
summary: An iOS-style action sheet that follows your finger and flings away to dismiss.
behavior: Drag anywhere on the sheet. Pull past a third of its height or flick down to dismiss; pulling up rubber-bands.
Springs up over a fading scrim. The exit is quicker than the entry and keeps a fling's momentum.
The sheet fades in and out in place instead of sliding up from the bottom.
A light impact when it opens and a selection tick when you pick an action. Turn off with haptics={false}.
The sheet is a modal view, the title is a header and each row is a button with its label and disabled state.
Escape closes it on web; the Android back button closes it too.
props: Called on actions, Cancel, backdrop tap, drag-down, back and Escape.
{ label, icon?, destructive?, disabled?, color?, onPress? }[]

The options. `icon` is a built-in name (camera, image, trash, reply, forward, copy, pin, edit, share, link, mail, …) or a node; destructive rows use the danger colour; return false from onPress to stay open; `color` tints grid tiles.
Separate cancel button; null hides it.
Called on Cancel, backdrop tap and drag-to-dismiss.
iOS grouped cards (text-only rows centred in the accent; rows with icons read like a menu), Material edge-to-edge list with a drag handle, or share-sheet tiles.
Padding above the home indicator; pass useSafeAreaInsets().bottom for the device.
Colour of text-only actions and Cancel in the inset variant.
Close on scrim tap, drag, back and Escape. When false the sheet only rubber-bands.
Light impact on open, selection tick when an action is picked.
